note: reach and hurt are the desk's own 1-5 estimates (5 = most adults / a serious, repeated loss), not survey figures; revise them when data says otherwise. months = when the problem peaks (1 = January). data: held = in our repo now, public = published but not yet read by us, none = no published source found. money = how a tool or story on it can earn under D-021: newsletter (Morning sign-ups), alerts (email/phone alerts), referral (an existing partner referral), sponsor (a sponsor slot on the page), pro (paid depth: history, exports, alerts), b2b (feeds the institutional data product). lib/mwananchi-core.ts scores every row; the desk shows the top of the list.
